children.game_version: The 'Vanara Army' game: children pretend to be the monkey army celebrating a victory.

seniors.seated_version: Perform rhythmic foot tapping while seated to sound the rings without the strain of standing for hours.
seniors.standing_version: Short duration rhythmic stepping while holding a support (like a chair or rail).
seniors.tempo_and_range: Reduce the 8-hour duration to 5-minute intervals; limit leg lift height.

movement_profile.footwork: Intricate movements designed to sound the iron rings
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Processional or temple-based; performed during car festivals

signature_moves.description: Rhythmic leg movements designed to make the ten iron rings on each leg collide
signature_moves.name: Anjali striking

movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Avoid exhaustion; the dance requires pacing for 5-8 hour durations.

music_profile.rhythm_pattern: Metallic percussive clanging from leg rings
music_profile.sound_description: The sound is dominated by the rhythmic, metallic jingling and clanging of twenty iron rings striking together with every step, layered over a foundation of traditional drumming.

basic_steps: Step firmly to engage the iron rings (anjali) on the lower legs
Execute rhythmic footwork to create a metallic clanging sound
Maintain a steady pace suitable for a multi-hour performance
teaching.formation: Group performance, often accompanying a procession
teaching.level_notes: Requires extreme physical endurance for 5-8 hour sessions.
teaching.rhythm: Percussive and metallic, driven by the leg rings
